chapters.reason: CDCD maps discrete language tokens to continuous embeddings and denoises latent vectors, aligning with Embedding-based Diffusion Models.
Diffusion for text sequences with masking; relevant as diffusion applied to language data, though CDCD emphasizes continuous input space.
Hybrid AR-Diffusion Models combine diffusion with autoregressive components; related diffusion paradigms for sequences though not the primary approach of CDCD.
